title: 宝塚記念の後に・トップ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Biwa Hayahide seizes a stunning victory at the Takarazuka Kinen! She's reached the top of the ranks!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We discuss our upcoming race schedule. Narita Brian will most likely aim for the Arima Kinen after winning the Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: So we decide to shoot for the autumn Tenno Sho and work on improving Biwa Hayahide's raw speed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the way home, I can't help but notice how tired Biwa Hayahide is. I try to think of what I can do to help.
